title: BundleTier
description: A tier in a product bundle, grouping product slots by price/quality level.

description.description: Brief description of what the tier includes.

slots.description: Product category slots within this tier.

categoryLabel.description: Display name of the product category for this slot.

childId.description: Id of the bundle-display child product-list node that renders this slot's products. Associates the slot with its child on the A2-UI composition plane; the renderer mounts the child via children(id).
